overview_description.description:
Transcend is the only autonomous “can I use this data” platform that powers every data decision to scale customer growth.
Fortune 500 companies and emerging category leaders leverage Transcend to encode complete data use permissions directly into the enterprise systems that process customer data, delivering a real-time source of truth for consent, preferences, and business rules. The result is superior data quality, ethical use that protects the brand, and audit-ready compliance at scale. With Transcend, companies can unlock revenue from AI, personalization, and other first-party data initiatives with confidence.
Founded in 2017 by Ben Brook (CEO) and Mike Farrell (CTO), Transcend is headquartered in the San Francisco Bay Area. The company has been recognized as a Leader in IDC’s MarketScape for Worldwide Data Privacy Compliance Software and twice named to the Deloitte Technology Fast 500™.

Learn more at transcend.io.

about_short_description.short_description: Transcend is the only autonomous "can I use this data" platform that powers every data decision to scale customer growth.

product.name: Transcend Data Decision Platform
product.description: A data governance platform that applies business policies, regulatory requirements, and customer permissions to data use across enterprise systems, AI models, and customer-facing applications.

product.name: Policy Engine
product.description: A real-time decision infrastructure that combines business policy, regulatory context, and customer permissions to determine how data may be used before a system or AI agent acts.

product.name: AI Governance
product.description: Governance controls for using customer data in AI systems, including real-time permission checks, data classification, and Do Not Train enforcement.

product.name: Consent & Preference Management
product.description: A consent and preference management system that collects, stores, and synchronizes customer choices across websites, mobile applications, CRM systems, CDPs, advertising platforms, and other channels.

product.name: DSR Automation
product.description: Automation for data subject requests, including access, deletion, correction, and related privacy rights workflows across connected enterprise systems.

product.name: Sombra Secure-by-Design
product.description: A security gateway deployed inside a customer’s environment to manage integrations and enforce data decisions while keeping customer data, credentials, and infrastructure under the customer’s control.
